EsrsStatement.title: ESRS Statement
EsrsStatement.description: A flat, self-contained CSRD/ESRS sustainability statement for one reporting period, capturing the period's quantitative ESRS datapoints (GHG Scope 1/2/3 + arithmetic total and intensity, energy mix, pollution, water, biodiversity, circular-economy, own-workforce, business-conduct metrics) and the cross-cutting targets[] set, plus the IFRS S2 climate-risk/opportunity exposures. Used by the sustainability rule domain to evaluate presence, sum, enumeration and threshold obligations of the ESRS (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772) and IFRS S2. Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure; it is the auditable reporting summary that sits above the granular GhgInventory / EmissionSource / EsrsDataPoint model.

reportingPeriod.description: Fiscal reporting period this statement covers, e.g. FY2025.

netRevenue.description: Net revenue (turnover) for the period in EUR, the denominator for all intensity datapoints (GHG, energy, water).

currency.description: ISO 4217 presentation currency of the monetary datapoints.

materialityAssessmentDone.description: True when the double-materiality assessment underpinning this statement has been completed (ESRS 1 / IRO-1).

datapointsTagged.description: True when the reported datapoints are tagged against the ESRS XBRL taxonomy (ESRS 2 IRO-2).

disclosureRequirementsCovered.description: List of ESRS disclosure-requirement codes this statement covers, e.g. E1-6, S1-6, G1-4 (ESRS 2 IRO-2).

highClimateImpactSector.description: True when the undertaking operates in a high-climate-impact sector, which makes the ESRS E1-5 energy-intensity disclosure mandatory.

financialSectorEntity.description: True for asset-management/banking/insurance entities, which makes the IFRS S2 financed-emissions disclosure mandatory.

ghgScope1.description: Gross Scope 1 GHG emissions in metric tonnes CO2-equivalent (ESRS E1-6 / IFRS S2).

ghgScope1EtsCoveredPct.description: Percentage (0-100) of Scope 1 emissions covered by a regulated emission-trading scheme (ESRS E1-6).

ghgScope2LocationBased.description: Gross Scope 2 GHG emissions, location-based, in tCO2e (ESRS E1-6 / IFRS S2).

ghgScope2MarketBased.description: Gross Scope 2 GHG emissions, market-based, in tCO2e (ESRS E1-6).

ghgScope3.description: Gross Scope 3 GHG emissions in tCO2e (ESRS E1-6 / IFRS S2). Equals the sum of scope3Categories[].value.

scope3Categories.description: Scope 3 emissions broken down by GHG-Protocol value-chain category. The values sum to ghgScope3 (ESRS E1-6).

ghgTotal.description: Total GHG emissions in tCO2e = ghgScope1 + ghgScope2LocationBased + ghgScope3 (ESRS E1-6).

ghgIntensity.description: GHG intensity = ghgTotal / netRevenue (tCO2e per EUR) (ESRS E1-6).

ghgRemovals.description: GHG removals and storage in own operations and value chain, in tCO2e (ESRS E1-7).

carbonCreditsCancelled.description: Carbon credits cancelled or planned to be cancelled, in tCO2e (ESRS E1-7).

internalCarbonPricingApplied.description: True when the undertaking applies an internal carbon price in decision-making (ESRS E1-8 / IFRS S2).

internalCarbonPrice.description: Internal carbon price applied per tCO2e; positive when internalCarbonPricingApplied is true (ESRS E1-8 / IFRS S2).

energyConsumption.description: Total energy consumption in MWh (ESRS E1-5). Equals energyFossil + energyNuclear + energyRenewable.

energyFossil.description: Energy consumption from fossil sources in MWh (ESRS E1-5).

energyNuclear.description: Energy consumption from nuclear sources in MWh (ESRS E1-5).

energyRenewable.description: Energy consumption from renewable sources in MWh (ESRS E1-5).

renewableEnergySharePct.description: Share of renewable energy in total consumption (0-100) = energyRenewable / energyConsumption * 100 (ESRS E1-5).

energyIntensity.description: Energy intensity = energyConsumption / netRevenue (MWh per EUR); mandatory in high-climate-impact sectors (ESRS E1-5).

pollutantsToAir.description: Amount of pollutants emitted to air in tonnes (ESRS E2-4).

pollutantsToWater.description: Amount of pollutants emitted to water in tonnes (ESRS E2-4).

pollutantsToSoil.description: Amount of pollutants emitted to soil in tonnes (ESRS E2-4).

substancesOfConcern.description: Quantity of substances of concern generated/used in tonnes (ESRS E2-5).

substancesOfVeryHighConcern.description: Quantity of substances of very high concern in tonnes (ESRS E2-5).

waterConsumption.description: Total water consumption in cubic metres (ESRS E3-4).

waterConsumptionAtRiskPct.description: Share of water consumption in areas at water risk (0-100) (ESRS E3-4).

waterIntensity.description: Water intensity = waterConsumption / netRevenue (m3 per EUR) (ESRS E3-4).

sitesNearBiodiversitySensitiveAreas.description: Number of own sites located in or near biodiversity-sensitive areas (ESRS E4-5).

materialsTotalWeight.description: Overall total weight of products and materials used (resource inflows) in tonnes (ESRS E5-4).

biologicalMaterialsSharePct.description: Share of biological materials in resource inflows (0-100) (ESRS E5-4).

secondaryMaterialsSharePct.description: Share of secondary (recycled) materials in resource inflows (0-100) (ESRS E5-4).

wasteTotalTonnes.description: Total waste generated in tonnes (ESRS E5-5).

wasteDivertedFromDisposalPct.description: Share of waste diverted from disposal (0-100); together with wasteDirectedToDisposalPct sums to 100 (ESRS E5-5).

wasteDirectedToDisposalPct.description: Share of waste directed to disposal (0-100) (ESRS E5-5).

employeeHeadcount.description: Total number of employees by head count (ESRS S1-6). Equals the sum of the gender breakdown.

employeeHeadcountOther.description: Number of employees of other/not-disclosed gender (ESRS S1-6).

nonEmployees.description: Total number of non-employees in own workforce (self-employed and agency workers) (ESRS S1-7).

collectiveBargainingCoveragePct.description: Percentage of employees covered by collective bargaining agreements (0-100) (ESRS S1-8).

topManagementFemalePct.description: Share of women at top-management level (0-100) (ESRS S1-9).

employeeAgeBands.description: Distribution of employees by age band; the counts sum to employeeHeadcount (ESRS S1-9).

band.description: Age band label, e.g. under-30, 30-50, over-50.

count.description: Number of employees in the band.

healthSafetyCoveragePct.description: Percentage of own workforce covered by the health-and-safety system (0-100) (ESRS S1-14).

recordableAccidents.description: Number of recordable work-related accidents (ESRS S1-14).

workRelatedFatalities.description: Number of work-related fatalities; cannot exceed recordableAccidents (ESRS S1-14).

genderPayGapPct.description: Gender pay gap as a percentage (may be negative) (ESRS S1-16).

ceoPayRatio.description: Ratio of the highest-paid individual's total remuneration to the median total remuneration (ESRS S1-16).

discriminationIncidents.description: Number of work-related incidents of discrimination (ESRS S1-17).

discriminationFines.description: Fines, penalties and compensation related to discrimination incidents, in EUR (ESRS S1-17).

corruptionIncidents.description: Number of confirmed incidents of corruption or bribery (ESRS G1-4).

corruptionConvictions.description: Number of convictions for corruption/bribery; cannot exceed corruptionIncidents (ESRS G1-4).

corruptionFines.description: Fines for violation of anti-corruption/anti-bribery laws, in EUR (ESRS G1-4).

averageDaysToPay.description: Average number of days to pay an invoice (ESRS G1-6).

standardPaymentTermDays.description: Standard contractual payment term in days (ESRS G1-6).

latePaymentProceedings.description: Number of legal proceedings for late payment (ESRS G1-6).

financedEmissions.description: Financed emissions in tCO2e (additional Scope 3); mandatory for financial-sector entities (IFRS S2).

transitionRiskAmount.description: Amount of assets/business activities vulnerable to climate-related transition risk, in EUR (IFRS S2).

transitionRiskPct.description: Percentage of assets/activities vulnerable to transition risk (0-100) (IFRS S2).

physicalRiskAmount.description: Amount of assets/activities vulnerable to climate-related physical risk, in EUR (IFRS S2).

physicalRiskPct.description: Percentage of assets/activities vulnerable to physical risk (0-100) (IFRS S2).

climateOpportunityAmount.description: Amount of assets/activities aligned with climate-related opportunities, in EUR (IFRS S2).

climateOpportunityPct.description: Percentage of assets/activities aligned with climate opportunities (0-100) (IFRS S2).

climateCapitalDeployed.description: Capital expenditure, financing or investment deployed towards climate risks/opportunities, in EUR (IFRS S2).

remunerationLinkedToClimatePct.description: Percentage of executive remuneration linked to climate considerations (0-100) (IFRS S2).

industryMetrics.description: List of disclosed industry-based (SASB) metric codes (IFRS S2).

targets.description: Cross-cutting measurable, outcome-oriented sustainability targets, one or more per material matter (ESRS 2 MDR-T; per-topic E1-4/E2-3/E3-3/E4-4/E5-3/S2-5/S3-5/S4-5).

matter.description: ESRS material matter code the target relates to (E1-E5, S1-S4, G1).

targetYear.description: Year the target is to be achieved; must be >= baseYear.

baseline.description: Baseline value the target is measured against.

metric.description: Unit/metric of the target, e.g. tCO2e, m3, percent.

targetType.description: Whether the target is absolute or intensity-based.

progressPct.description: Progress against the target so far (0-100).
